answer: Test what an agent can do, not who it claims to be: each identity must solve a 200-prompt benchmark in a 90-second window, scoring at least 70% against hidden answers. One GPU manages at most 3 runs, so 100 fakes need 33 GPUs, and that cost is the echo of each fake. A ferrous marble stays on one track: each seed binds to one identity, so no solved run can be replayed. Three failures suspend the identity for 7 days.
